facts: Which New Seven Wonder is in India?
The Taj Mahal is in Agra, India.
Mughal emperor Shah Jahan commissioned the Taj Mahal.
Which wonder stretches across northern China?
The Great Wall is a network of fortifications across northern China.
Why were sections of the Great Wall built?
Different dynasties built and rebuilt walls for defense and frontier management.
Which rock-cut wonder is in Jordan?
Petra was an important Nabataean city in present-day Jordan.
Which people developed Petra as a major city?
The Nabataeans made Petra a wealthy trade centre.
Which ancient amphitheatre is in Rome?
The Colosseum is a Roman amphitheatre.
What was the Colosseum used for in ancient Rome?
It hosted gladiatorial contests and other public spectacles.
Which Inca site stands high in the Andes?
Machu Picchu is an Inca site in present-day Peru.
Machu Picchu was built by the Inca civilisation.
Which Maya site includes El Castillo?
Chichén Itzá is a major Maya archaeological site in Mexico.
Chichén Itzá was a major Maya centre.
Which wonder overlooks Rio de Janeiro?
The statue stands on Corcovado mountain above Rio de Janeiro.
On which mountain does Christ the Redeemer stand?
Christ the Redeemer stands on Corcovado mountain.
When was the New Seven Wonders list announced?
The modern New Seven Wonders list was announced in 2007.
How was the New Seven Wonders list selected?
By an ancient Roman senate vote
A private foundation ran a worldwide public voting campaign.
Which Ancient Wonder still substantially survives?
The Great Pyramid is the only Ancient Wonder still largely standing.
Where is the Great Pyramid of Giza?
The Great Pyramid is on the Giza plateau in Egypt.
What is UNESCO’s role at many heritage sites?
Choosing the New Seven Wonders list
UNESCO designates World Heritage Sites and supports preservation frameworks.
Why is conservation important at famous monuments?
Conservation helps preserve sites for future generations.
What natural process can slowly damage stone monuments?
Wind, rain, temperature changes, and salts can weather stone.
Why must tourism be managed at fragile heritage sites?
Large crowds can cause wear and damage
Visitor pressure can damage paths, surfaces, and structures.
What does archaeology study at ancient sites?
Material evidence of past human life
Archaeology examines structures, objects, and other physical evidence.
Why is an artefact’s archaeological context important?
It helps explain when and how it was used
Location and association with other finds help interpret artefacts.
What is a good rule when visiting a historic monument?
Follow site rules and do not damage surfaces
Respectful behaviour helps protect cultural heritage.
